title: functions_pipeline/1
description: Every enquiry on the monday.com FUNCTIONS ENQUIRY TRACKER (board 5027645686), including the archive group. Written by modules/functions/pipeline/build_functions_pipeline.py from data/functions_monday_raw.json; read by the Pipeline tab of the functions screen. Additive changes only -- dashboard/functions/ is deployed and a stale browser tab is still reading the old field names.

captured_at.description: When the BOARD was read, not when this file was written. It is the age of every fact below and a consumer must show it: a stale feed presented as live is worse than an empty one.

groups.description: The board's own groups, in board order. Carried so the screen can group by them rather than inventing a grouping, and so `archive` is visible as a place rather than as an absence.

flag.description: Something in the board data that a person has to resolve. NEVER resolved here: two dates for one party is a question, and picking one silently is how the wrong Saturday gets held.

others.description: The monday item ids this finding is about, for date_shared.

id.description: monday:<item id>. Same string as source_ref; the join key a screen bookmarks.

source_ref.description: What a brief made from this row carries. The bookings service upserts briefs on source_ref, so pressing 'Take a deposit' twice -- or re-running the sync -- converges on one brief instead of littering.

url.description: The monday row itself. The board is still where this is edited.

name.description: The row title, as typed. Inconsistent on purpose -- 'Michael - 25 Oct', 'Roman', 'trinette' are all real -- and not normalised, because the title is also where a hand-written date lives.

archived.description: In the board's `archive` group. Published, never dropped: 36 of the 60 rows are archived and a pipeline that hid them would report 24.

revenue_dollars.description: What they actually spent, after the event. Distinct from min_spend.

area.description: The board's Area label. NOT necessarily an area the engine accepts -- 'Whole venue' and 'Not sure yet' are both board answers and neither is bookable.

source.description: How they heard about us. The only channel attribution the business has.

drinks.description: The board's Drinks label, price suffix and all. The engine's vocabulary is in brief_prefill.drink.

min_spend_cents.description: Whole cents. Money is never a float in this repo.

notes.description: The running log IN FULL, verbatim. Never summarised: on this board the note contradicts the columns more than once.

notes_truncated.description: The note is at monday's 2000-character cap and therefore ends mid-sentence. TRUE means what is shown is not the whole record, and the missing part is the most recent part.

log_entries.description: How many dated entries the log has.

log_last_author.description: Who wrote the last one -- 'auto' or a person's name.

whose_move.description: Read from the LAST dated entry of the log and nothing else. 'nobody' means the row has no notes at all. 'unclear' is a real answer and is drawn as one -- it is NOT collapsed into 'them', because a wrong 'waiting on them' is indistinguishable from 'nothing to do'.

whose_move_evidence.description: The last log entry VERBATIM. The screen shows this beside the verdict so the verdict can be checked against the sentence it was read off.

whose_move_why.description: Which phrase decided it, in words.

outstanding.description: What is still to pin down, using the booking engine's own labels (functions.REQUIRED) so the two ends agree. Contact details are deliberately not in it -- if there is no email and no phone there is nobody to ask; see contactable.

brief_prefill.description: The body for POST /api/admin/functions if somebody presses 'Take a deposit' on this row -- and nothing creates it until they do. NULL for Harry Gatos, which has no floor plan in the engine, so no brief there could ever hold a room. Values are mapped into the engine's vocabulary: the board's 'SOIRÈE $60pp' is the engine's 'SOIRÈE', because a package name is a price and validate() rejects one it does not know.
